question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The chemical spray is a very useful and distant weapon that may be used to attack from a long distance, ________ additional safety.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1) i.e. "ensuring".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ensuring: (सुनिश्चित करना) **- Making certain that something shall occur or be the case.

 
 
• **Example**: Ensuring the security of the building is the guard’s primary responsibility.
 
 
 
• The word fits contextually because it talks about the chemical spray adding an extra layer of safety when used, which is precisely what ensuring conveys in this context.

**Therefore, the correct complete sentence is *"The chemical spray is a very useful and distant weapon that may be used to attack from a long distance, ensuring__ additional safety."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Minimising**: (कम से कम करना) - Reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree.
 
• **Following**: (अनुसरण करना) - Coming after or as a result of.
 
• **Developing**:(विकसित करना) - Start to exist, experience, or possess.
